posts.headline: Gooey Butter Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 350 and grease a 9 by 13 pan.
Mix cake mix, 1 egg and melted butter. Press it into the pan.
Beat cream cheese, 2 eggs, vanilla and most of the powdered sugar until smooth.
Pour over the crust and bake about 40 minutes, until golden with a soft middle.
Cool, then dust with the rest of the powdered sugar.
posts.text:
Holiday baking season is here, and nothing says Missouri like gooey butter cake. It is easy enough to make with Mom or the grandkids.

Press a crust of cake mix, an egg and melted butter into a pan. Beat cream cheese, two eggs, vanilla and powdered sugar and pour it on top. Bake at 350 for about 40 minutes. Let it cool and dust with more sugar.

slides.title: Pushy means hang up
slides.body: Real companies and agencies do not rush you or threaten you. It is fine to hang up.

slides.body: Anyone asking to be paid with store cards, wire transfers or crypto is a scam.

slides.body: Scammers pretend to be a grandchild in a jam. Hang up and call the grandchild directly.

slides.body: Do not give out bank, card or Social Security numbers to someone who called you.

posts.headline: Old-Fashioned Persimmon Pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 325 and butter a 9 by 13 pan.
Mix the persimmon pulp, sugar, eggs and buttermilk.
Stir in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt, then the butter.
Pour into the pan and bake about 1 hour, until set and dark.
Serve warm with whipped cream.
posts.text:
If you grew up in Missouri, you may remember gathering soft, wrinkly persimmons in the fall. This pudding is a true old timer.

Mix 2 cups pulp, 1 1/2 cups sugar, 2 eggs and 1 1/2 cups buttermilk. Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour, 1 tsp each soda and cinnamon, a pinch of salt and 1/4 cup melted butter. Bake at 325 about an hour. Serve warm.
